title: Objectives
body:
I used to use OpenAPS, then migrated to AndroidAPS when it became available - and one of you told me how to bypass the objectives, as I'd been using OpenAPS for years.

In 2020 I was offered CamAPS by my consultant.  I used it for 3 years, but then had had enough of it - and went back to AAPS which gave me much better control.  That was in May 2023.

Inbetween you had changed the format / encryption of the preferences file - and my old file would not load.  I enquired on Social Media how to bypass it - but most of the respones just flamed me!  Someone commented my only option was to edit the code.  

After a lot of figuring out, I eventually got it working.
Now comes the next manatory update, saying my copy will expire in April.

Is there a better option than editing the code for each update?  I'm an OK C++ Programmer but Android is a mystery to me!
I appreciate you probably don't want to say how in public.  If you would be prepared to tell me privately, my mail is simon1@psi-design.co.uk
I'll provide whatever evidence I can to proove I'm not just trying to bypass the system.

comments.body:
In the documentation it says, if you put your old preferences file in the root of the phone, it will load.  However, in V3.X it does not work.
I guess this was a one-time deal for a particular version?
Is there a version available, I can compile with this feature?
